# dockerfile-audit

> Audit Dockerfiles for security mistakes with nine rules: unpinned bases, root user, remote ADD, secrets in ENV or ARG, curl piped to shell and more, with text and JSON output Go module `github.com/Trysac/u157-dockerfile-audit`, package `dockerfileaudit`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
